description: Microstat brings social media analytics into ChatGPT. Explore connected communities, compare available follower trends and post performance, search collected posts, and export reports. Compare recent posts from supported public VK, Telegram and Odnoklassniki communities by URL. Use archived posts and approved brand knowledge as context for drafting copy. Available metrics and historical coverage depend on the platform, granted access and collected data; unavailable metrics are reported as missing. Microstat does not publish or delete social media posts. Some tools update Microstat settings, imports or report schedules when requested.
